_readme: A Moveable Feast and The Plague turned out to be metadata-less stubs, not fully-populated entries as initially assumed. Filling in synopsis/genre now from the real fetched text already reviewed for the main pdf-batch-07-26-group import.

books.title: A Moveable Feast
books.author: Ernest Hemingway
books.synopsis: Hemingway recalls his poor, hungry early years in 1920s Paris — writing in cafés, sparring with Gertrude Stein and Ford Madox Ford, and watching a reckless, talented Fitzgerald begin to unravel — in a posthumously published memoir of the Lost Generation.

books.title: The Plague
books.author: Albert Camus
books.synopsis: A doctor in the Algerian city of Oran leads the fight against a rat-borne epidemic that seals the city's gates, an existentialist parable of absurdity, solidarity, and the will to keep struggling against a fate you cannot beat.
